basis.source: Tracked local site files, shared-navigation script, release notes and native publication metadata. Live deployed routes were not audited.
basis.verification: Routes and metadata inspected; product recipes listed below were not executed by this inventory.

final_ia.navigation_rule: Task names lead to an executable case. Avoid a Guides bucket containing feature catalogues and raw reports. Historical readers and all native immutable assets stay outside primary navigation and current search.
final_ia.planned_example_generation: Fresh output from final installed published release, source revision and runtime recorded; no hand edits to generated publication bytes.

release_and_source_boundaries.old_reader_renderer_version: Installed0.13.10, reported from prior implementation provenance and official byte-equivalence verification. The public publication.json does not bind the CLI runtime; this inventory did not independently rerun that provenance check.
recorded_limits: Five ACCEPTED narrative sections; final publication PARTIAL with 15 worker/NOTE gaps.
UNVERIFIED pinned source freshness; runtime UNKNOWN.
Source-syntax and FILE_ONLY evidence do not establish compiler call relations or runtime behavior.
Current 0.13.10 UI/help does not reinterpret the old accepted source narrative.
release_and_source_boundaries.future_rule: New public documentation must be authored from fresh final-release native evidence and generated by the final installed release. If0.13.10 is superseded during implementation, use and report the final published tag. Existing recorded source versions and bundles remain historical.
release_and_source_boundaries.renderer_authority: Prior implementation evidence reported by the coordinating agent; public qualification.json binds the accepted source narrative to 0.13.7. Keep renderer version separate from authoring version and source revision.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer evaluating Clew for a real repository
top_level_pages.engineer_question: Can Clew help me answer a source question, produce a document, or review my saved edits?
top_level_pages.useful_result: Install the public release, inspect supported scope, then choose one of three tasks.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Product pitch and a long matrix compete with the first useful action.
required_evidence: Installed final release version and capabilities; support matrix from the same release; one successful task per advertised path.
top_level_pages.next_action: Install, then choose Find the code, Create a first document, or Review saved edits.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer with a named function or a precise source question
top_level_pages.engineer_question: Where is the function I need, and can I inspect the exact saved code?
top_level_pages.useful_result: Discover a repository profile, find one exact declaration, open retained source, then decide what remains unresolved.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Explains Clew navigation internals at an old Rust revision instead of teaching a repository task. Existing explanation is a 0.3.1 Rust walkthrough.
required_evidence: Fresh final-release navigation on one public committed Rust scope; real returned identity, source excerpt, and a deliberate no-match/ABSTAIN result.
top_level_pages.next_action: Run the same discovery and navigation on your repository; choose documentation if the explanation must be kept.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer creating the first useful explanation for a colleague
top_level_pages.engineer_question: How do I turn one committed source file into a readable, source-linked document?
top_level_pages.useful_result: A real overview in a local reader, one saved-source question, and a demonstrated update that preserves prior notes/publications.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Many features and historical samples surround the starter; broad service and process promises lack an end-to-end practical reader journey.
required_evidence: Final installed release; complete native source packet; authored proposal; structural readiness; explicit meaning status; actual reader path and source links; before/after preservation evidence.
top_level_pages.next_action: Create the overview, open one citation, then ask one saved-source question; optional update follows the same case.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer reviewing saved Kotlin or Rust changes before a commit
top_level_pages.engineer_question: Which declaration changed, which direct connection deserves inspection, and what should I verify next?
top_level_pages.useful_result: Read a guided three-change case, produce the same local report, distinguish change evidence from a suggested verification.
top_level_pages.current_problem: The workflow lists commands but sends the reader into a raw graph and several separate verification concepts.
required_evidence: Final-release run on a public fixture; body/signature/removed-call cases; exact before/after excerpts; main/test selection; freshness after another edit; explicit tests-not-run result.
top_level_pages.next_action: Produce a report for your saved files, inspect a direct consumer, choose and run your project verification separately.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer arriving through an existing example URL
top_level_pages.engineer_question: What does this report tell me to inspect first?
top_level_pages.useful_result: The guided example explains price body change, label signature change, removed call, and the next checks before opening the retained report.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Raw first screen presents graph/report mechanics without an engineer decision. Prior browser review reported the 1280×720 first screen filled by hero content, followed by a large Pricing.price graph without a clear engineer decision.
required_evidence: Retain existing report bytes or source data with a digest; validate any historical report relocation, its embedded data and relative assets; guided case uses fresh final-release evidence.
top_level_pages.next_action: Redirect to the integrated guide example; make the historical report an optional labeled evidence link.

replacement.historical_report_policy: Preserve the existing URL bytes until a verified archival copy exists. A copied historical report must keep its evidence unchanged and have working relative assets; redirects must not overwrite the only retained report.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer deciding how much to trust an answer
top_level_pages.engineer_question: What source did Clew capture and what does this analysis establish?
top_level_pages.useful_result: A short source-to-answer explanation and an actionable distinction between syntax, compiler facts, review, freshness and runtime unknowns.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Separate architecture page explains pipeline layers rather than helping a reader assess a result.
required_evidence: Final-release capabilities and one real result showing source selection and coverage; keep historical entry-point studies identified by version.
top_level_pages.next_action: Read source limits next to your chosen task; contributors follow the repository architecture references.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer checking a current claim or investigating an older example
top_level_pages.engineer_question: What was actually checked for this release, and which claims remain historical?
top_level_pages.useful_result: See final-release task checks first; follow versioned historical samples only with their original scope, source revision and limitations.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Title suggests current evidence while content leads with the old v0.13.1 Java draft. The hero says historical 0.13.1 while shared navigation implies current release evidence.
required_evidence: Final installed version and runtime identity; factual command outcomes for the three practical tasks; original old JSON and native publication digests; no extrapolated timing claims.
top_level_pages.next_action: Open the relevant task, installed-release evidence, or one explicitly historical sample.

top_level_pages.engineer_question: Which layer owns my change, and what would prove useful output?
top_level_pages.useful_result: Choose one layer, fixture and public command; use the repository development instructions and focused verification.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Mostly useful; duplicates long contract and test prose that can live in source documentation.
required_evidence: Links to current source interfaces and repository instructions; one concrete existing test/fixture per layer; clearly marked proposed example.
top_level_pages.next_action: Open the source repository and its contribution instructions; keep this link in the footer.

top_level_pages.reader: Engineer studying the original two-service Spring case
top_level_pages.engineer_question: What did the earlier 31-root source inventory establish?
top_level_pages.useful_result: Inspect the historical method and supported source boundaries without treating it as current-release qualification.
top_level_pages.current_problem: Historical pilot is presented as a peer of everyday tasks; source/configuration observations can be mistaken for deployment evidence.
required_evidence: Original v0.3.1 sources and evidence; original scope, declared trigger families, and runtime limits.
top_level_pages.next_action: Open from Checks and limits under Historical studies; follow the current Find the code task for a new repository.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Will the final published release remain 0.13.10 or include linked-process changes?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Freeze and install the final published tag before generating new public docs and final command evidence.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Can the reported installed 0.13.10 renderer provenance be made explicit in the new public evidence without relabeling old native bytes?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Prior implementation reportedly verified official byte equivalence. The new case must record installed version/runtime/source revision directly; preserve old manifests unchanged.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Which exact committed public scope yields the clearest first-document and linked-process example with sufficient helper/configuration context?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Start with build_cli_documentation.py; inspect the final native packet and scope dependencies before choosing a broader example. Do not reuse the huge ten-root recorded packet for onboarding.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Which final native process selection and accepted output can be shown as a useful practical result?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Generate one real final-release case. Keep the old TaskStateTransitions draft historical and locally unpublished; do not elevate its status.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Can the existing raw report be archived with all embedded data and relative assets intact before replacing its public entry route?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Verify a byte-preserving copy and open it offline. Until then, retain the old URL as historical and remove it from primary navigation only.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Which redirect/deep-fragment behavior is supported by the repository Pages deployment?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Use static redirect stubs with visible fallback links and an explicit old-anchor map; check base/codeclew paths and Back behavior in the deployed-equivalent preview.

unresolved_factual_questions.question: Does a new final-release native publication emit coherent root links for index/catalog/history/help/runbooks?
unresolved_factual_questions.resolution: Observed old help/runbooks target aa52 while index/catalog target ef418; exercise all fresh native root routes, and fix the renderer if the mixed-bundle defect recurs instead of patching generated HTML.
